name: ethio-tourist-destination
description: One-command fullstack dev: API (6000) + React (5173, proxied /api)

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix tourist-destination-campaign
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix tourist-destination-campaign"
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix tourist-destination-campaign && npm start --prefix backend
